objective: After manager integration of this packet, repair only CFR-168 C14-LIVE-A2/B3 on the accepted Python HTTP Upload mutation-response path: freeze the conservative EFFECT_MAY_HAVE_STARTED boundary, transfer the selected prepared owner to the mutation slot before fallible rejected cleanup, keep wire publication as a borrow, separate pre-effect abort from post-effect finish, retry cleanup exactly once on the same non-consuming owner, preserve one response attempt, and report ADR-020-compatible decision-work and separate wire state.

risk.rationale: The repair crosses durable-effect, response ownership, request-loop accounting, socket framing, error-origin, and canonical-contract boundaries. Historical GET and MR-write sources gave conflicting post-effect cleanup rules, and a later manager adjudication corrects the terminal interpretation, so exact phase assignment and an independent Ultra review are mandatory.

disallowed_actions: starting implementation before the manager integrates this packet and names full execution base L
changing product, tests, source docs, issue state, install state, or dogfood state in the packet-authoring lane
using an execution base whose product/test/ADR/source-doc/issue blobs differ from P
changing the typed base_revision to make a generic launcher accept a different base
adding a tenth path to candidate C or placing a result/review/history/current-state artifact inside C
amending, squashing, rebasing, merging, or rewriting candidate C after Candidate Freeze
running fallible rejected-owner cleanup before the selected owner reaches the mutation slot
transferring the Upload selected owner out of the slot with take, clone, re-encoding, or reconstruction
using one generic slot close to choose both pre-effect abort and post-effect finish semantics
closing or clearing the selected owner before its one post-M wire attempt
calling the opposite selector after a selection direction starts
placing accounting cleanup, diagnostic work, or terminal observation inside transport_boundary
attempting send_json, prepare_json, or a second HTTP document after WIRE_STARTED
retrying cleanup more than once synchronously, adopting it in a later request, or treating __del__ as evidence
clearing an owner, scalar, debt, or permit before its exact release succeeds
inventing publication_failed, wire_failed, response_abandoned, or another advertised decision-work terminal
overwriting an earlier budget_exceeded, subject_changed, deadline_exceeded, or other valid terminal
classifying failure origin from message text, errno, exception class, traceback, or timing
changing GET/read-slot semantics or slotless GC/MR POST behavior
implementing C14-LIVE-A1, C14-SUCCESSOR-OWNER, MR-write, reducer, nonce, gate, recovery, ancestry, signature, validation, bootstrap, GC, Rust, packaging, install, Docker, or dogfood work
claiming B3, C14, MR-write, CFR-168, CFB-136, CFB-138, the batch, Install, Dogfood, or Retrospect complete
performing implementation and independent review in the same lane
repairing a reviewer preference without manager actionability adjudication and a frozen required-correction scope

non_goals: C14-LIVE-A1 constructor-unwind, commit-source, server-verification, signature, ancestry, or other pre-effect cleanup work.
C14-SUCCESSOR-OWNER production-unwired/deferred factories, sealed ancestry, control witness, O2, or O3.
GET/read response-slot behavior or its accepted pre-effect dispose-before-select rule.
Wiring the A2 mutation slot into GC or merge-request create/review/apply routes.
MR-write implementation, accepted-base rebinding, review/apply work, or clearing its B1 blocker.
Publication reducer, nonce, gate, recovery, object-copy, ancestry, signature, validation, bootstrap, authority, or GC semantics.
Rust, Cargo, schemas, conformance, capability advertisement, packaging, Install, Docker, network, Dogfood, or Retrospect.
A new advertised decision-work terminal reason or an ADR-020 vocabulary change.
Unbounded/background/cross-request cleanup retry or destructor-based correctness.
Proving the actual first durable byte, peer receipt, TCP flush, or filesystem visibility from M or wire states.
Closing B3, global C14, CFR-168, CFB-136, CFB-138, MR-write, or the active batch from this slice.
Management/current-state/history/flow/review artifact changes inside the nine-path candidate.
Unrelated refactor, rename, formatting sweep, performance optimization, or style-only cleanup.

invariants.falsification_test: Any opposite-selection transition, selected owner visible to generic pair cleanup, pointer cleared before release, or unguarded state skip.

invariants.statement: The slot follows EMPTY -> PREPARED -> SEALED -> EFFECT_MAY_HAVE_STARTED -> SELECTED -> WIRE_STARTED -> WIRE_COMPLETE -> CLEANUP_PENDING -> CLOSED, with explicit pre-effect abort and post-effect finish branches.
invariants.falsification_test: A post-WIRE_STARTED return to selection/send-json, a generic close choosing both policies, or a persistent owner cleared before observation.

invariants.statement: The exact selected owner reaches slot.selected and leaves the pair before the first fallible rejected-owner cleanup; after failure the slot owns selected and the pair owns only rejected cleanup.
invariants.falsification_test: Inject the first rejected close failure; selected is absent from the slot, still owned/closable by the pair, cloned, re-encoded, or destroyed.

invariants.statement: The Upload mutation slot remains canonical owner through terminal observation; wire publication borrows exact frozen header/body and no local take/clone/re-encoding splits ownership.
invariants.falsification_test: A local prepared owner outlives or bypasses the slot, response identity changes, or observer cannot reach a persistent remainder.

invariants.statement: Before M, abort publishes nothing when disposal is uncertain; at/after M, finish never destroys selected before its wire attempt and cleanup remains secondary.
invariants.falsification_test: T01 emits bytes/effects or T03/T04 loses/replaces the selected response.

invariants.statement: After M, confirmed matching reducer return selects exact prepared success; unconfirmed publication selects exact fixed durable 503; selection never changes.
invariants.falsification_test: A confirmed path emits durable, an unconfirmed path emits success/arbitrary error, payload is re-encoded, or opposite selection succeeds.

invariants.statement: WIRE_STARTED precedes the first header write attempt; only socket writes/flush carry transport origin; after WIRE_STARTED no second HTTP document is possible.
invariants.falsification_test: Header/body fault appends another status/document, WIRE_STARTED is set after write returns, or cleanup OSError is transport-marked.

invariants.statement: A failed A2 cleanup retains a non-consuming exact owner and receives exactly one synchronous retry on the same owner, two total attempts; no destructor/background/cross-request retry is correctness evidence.
invariants.falsification_test: Attempt count differs, owner identity changes, retry loops, a next request adopts it, or only __del__ drains it.

invariants.statement: After persistent cleanup failure, connection closes, no second response occurs, terminal is cleanup_incomplete for residual debt/permits, and observer exposes the reachable exact owner and debt without clearing them.
invariants.falsification_test: Observer reports complete/zero while release failed, owner is unreachable, connection continues, or a second response is attempted.

invariants.statement: Recovered cleanup reaches zero debt/permits, terminal complete unless an earlier valid terminal exists, and consumes one bounded secondary diagnostic; clean requests emit none.
invariants.falsification_test: Recovered request is cleanup_incomplete/new terminal, diagnostic is unread/duplicated/primary, or a clean request logs cleanup.

invariants.statement: Decision-work terminal describes accounting, not wire delivery: zero uses complete, residual uses existing cleanup_incomplete, earlier valid terminals are preserved, and no new advertised publication/wire terminal is added.
invariants.falsification_test: Code/ADR/docs add a new terminal, overwrite an earlier terminal, label residual complete, or encode wire progress in terminal reason.

invariants.statement: Socket failures are transport-origin; post-write accounting cleanup is outside transport; pre-M filesystem errors remain typed filesystem authority; MemoryError remains outside that arm.
invariants.falsification_test: Classification uses class/message/errno, cleanup OSError becomes transport, filesystem ETIMEDOUT abandons instead of typed 400, or MemoryError is encoded as filesystem.
